text.p: Profiles of Haile Gebrselassie and Noureddine Morceli who race over two miles on Saturday:

HAILE GEBRSELASSIE (Ethiopia), 24. Current world record holder over 5,000 metres, both indoors and outdoors. Has won gold medals over 10,000 metres at the 1993 and 1995 world championships and 1996 Olympic Games. Lives in the Netherlands for much of the year, especially when competing in Europe. Promoted to the honorary rank of major in the Ethiopian army after his Atlanta triumph although not a member of the military.

NOUREDDINE MORCELI (Algeria), 27. Gold medallist over 1,500 metres at the last three world championships and 1996 Olympic Games. Current holder of the world records over 1,500 metres, mile and 2,000 metres. Unbeaten over 45 finals for more than four years from 1992 until September 1996. Coached by elder brother Abderahmane, a top class middle distance runner in the late 1970s.
